 return 0.5 * coverage + 0.5 * inlier_ratio\n\n\ndef _clip_bounds(\n    left: int,\n    top: int,\n    right: int,\n    bottom: int,\n    width: int,\n    height: int,\n) -&gt; Tuple[int, int, int, ransac_reproj_threshold: float,\n) -&gt; Dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Run ORB + BFMatcher + RANSAC and return raw match artifacts.\"\"\"\n    template_gray = cv2.cvtColor(template_bgr, \"kp_target\": kp_target or [],\n        \"good_matches\": [],\n        \"homography\": None,\n        \"inlier_mask\": None,\n        \"inlier_count\": 0,\n    }\n\n    if des_template is None or continue\n        m, n = pair\n        if m.distance &lt; ratio_test_threshold * n.distance:\n            good_matches.append(m)\n\n    result[\"good_matches\"] = good_matches\n    if result[\"inlier_count\"] = int(inlier_mask.ravel().sum())\n\n    return result\n\n\ndef check_image_match_feature(\n    payload: Dict[str, Any],\n    output: Path | None = None,\n) -&gt; CheckResult:\n    \"\"\"\n    Feature-based image matching using ORB + BFMatcher + RANSAC.\n\n    Payload fields:\n    - template_image / template / small_image\n    - target_image / target / large_image / screenshot\n    - similarity_threshold (default 0.35)\n    - orb_nfeatures (default 2000)\n    - ratio_test_threshold (default 0.75)\n    - min_good_matches (default 12)\n    - min_inliers (default 8)\n    - ransac_reproj_threshold (default 5.0)\n    \"\"\"\n    template_path = _resolve_template_image(payload)\n    target_path = _resolve_target_image(payload)\n\n    similarity_threshold = float(\n        payload.get(\"similarity_threshold\", DEFAULT_FEATURE_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD)\n    )\n    nfeatures = int(payload.get(\"orb_nfeatures\", DEFAULT_ORB_NFEATURES))\n    ratio_test_threshold = float(\n        payload.get(\"ratio_test_threshold\", DEFAULT_RATIO_TEST_THRESHOLD)\n    )\n    min_good_matches = int(payload.get(\"min_good_matches\", template_pil = load_image(template_path)\n    target_pil = load_image(target_path)\n\n    # Keep the same convention as template matching: search small image in large image.\n    tw, th = template_pil.size\n    gw, gh = target_pil.size\n    swapped_by_size = (tw * th) &gt; (gw * gh)\n    if swapped_by_size:\n        template_pil, target_pil = target_pil, template_pil\n        template_path, target_path = target_path, template_path\n\n    template_cv = _pil_to_cv2(template_pil)\n    target_cv = _pil_to_cv2(target_pil)\n    target_h, target_w = target_cv.shape[:2]\n\n    raw = _feature_match(\n        template_cv,\n        target_cv,\n        nfeatures=nfeatures,\n        ratio_test_threshold=ratio_test_threshold,\n        min_good_matches=min_good_matches,\n        ransac_reproj_threshold=ransac_reproj_threshold,\n    )\n\n    kp_template = raw[\"kp_template\"]\n    kp_target = raw[\"kp_target\"]\n    good_matches: List[cv2.DMatch] = raw[\"good_matches\"]\n    homography = raw[\"homography\"]\n    inlier_mask = raw[\"inlier_mask\"]\n    inlier_count = int(raw[\"inlier_count\"])\n\n    bounds_tuple = (0, 0, 0, 0)\n    polygon: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []\n\n        int(np.floor(xs.min())),\n            int(np.floor(ys.min())),\n            int(np.ceil(xs.max())),\n            int(np.ceil(ys.max())),\n            target_w,\n            target_h,\n        )\n        bounds_tuple = (left, top, right, bottom)\n        polygon = [\n            (int(round(x)), int(round(y)))\n            for x, y in projected\n        ]\n    elif good_matches:\n        # int(np.ceil(ys.max())),\n            target_w,\n            target_h,\n        )\n        bounds_tuple = (left, top, right, bottom)\n\n    similarity = _compute_similarity(\n len(good_matches) &gt;= min_good_matches\n        and inlier_count &gt;= min_inliers\n        and similarity &gt;= similarity_threshold\n    )\n\n    bounds = Bounds.from_sequence(bounds_tuple)\n    if passed:\n        basis = (\n            f\"image_match_feature: Found template in target image with similarity={similarity:.4f} \"\n            f\"(threshold={similarity_threshold:.4f}), inliers={inlier_count}/{len(good_matches)}, \"\n            f\"bounds={bounds.as_box()}\"\n        )\n    else:\n        basis = (\n            f\"image_match_feature: Template not found. \"\n ---

已帮你加好了，新增了一个**基于特征点**的图像匹配实现，和现有多尺度模板匹配并行存在，方便直接对比。

### 改动内容
- 新增文件：`AIChecker/aichecker/checkers/image_match_checker_feature.py`
  - 提供 `check_image_match_feature(payload, output=None) -> CheckResult`
  - 算法：`ORB + BFMatcher(KNN ratio test) + RANSAC Homography`
  - 输出内容和现有 checker 风格一致：`passed / basis / control_info / details`
  - 调试图输出：
    - `feature_match_result.png`（目标图上的匹配框/多边形）
    - `feature_matches.png`（特征点连线）
    - `template.png`
    - `target.png`
- 更新导出：`AIChecker/aichecker/checkers/__init__.py`
  - 新增 `check_image_match_feature`
  - 新增默认阈值常量 `DEFAULT_FEATURE_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD`

### 可调参数（payload）
- `similarity_threshold`（默认 `0.35`）
- `orb_nfeatures`（默认 `2000`）
- `ratio_test_threshold`（默认 `0.75`）
- `min_good_matches`（默认 `12`）
- `min_inliers`（默认 `8`）
- `ransac_reproj_threshold`（默认 `5.0`）

### 你可以这样调用
```python
from aichecker.checkers import check_image_match_feature

result = check_image_match_feature(payload, output=debug_dir)
print(result.passed, result.details["similarity"], result.details["bounds"])
```

### 说明
- 我做了语法检查（通过）。
- 在你当前数据上做了一个 smoke test，`bilibili_2` 这例返回 `good_matches=0`（说明该样本对 ORB 特征不友好，常见于低纹理/纯色 UI 图标）。  
  这正好可以用于和模板匹配对比：有些图标模板匹配更强，有些复杂纹理图特征法更稳。
